widget.name: IRIS World Map
widget.description: Interactive world map (AG Charts Enterprise Maps) that highlights countries and plots business locations as size-scaled bubble markers from a Mendix datasource, with optional connection lines between them. Geographic rendering (country geometry, tooltips, zoom/pan) is fully owned by AG Charts; this widget only supplies business data, interaction and visual theme. Requires an AG Charts Enterprise licence for production use — see the widget's README.

property.caption: Regions
property.description: Datasource of business locations to plot on the map.

property.caption: Region ID
property.description: Unique, stable identifier for the region.

property.caption: Country Code
property.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code, e.g. "KR" or "KOR".

property.caption: Name
property.description: Display name shown in the tooltip, e.g. "Korea HQ".

property.caption: Latitude
property.description: Marker latitude in decimal degrees.

property.caption: Longitude
property.description: Marker longitude in decimal degrees.

property.caption: Status
property.description: Free-text status used to color the marker, e.g. "active" / "warning" / "inactive".

property.caption: Category
property.description: Optional grouping shown in the tooltip, e.g. "Factory" / "Office" / "Warehouse".

property.caption: Value
property.description: Optional numeric metric shown in the tooltip and used to size the bubble marker (see Min/Max Marker Size). Regions without a value get a fixed-size marker.

property.caption: Connections
property.description: Optional datasource of lines drawn between two region country codes.

property.caption: From Country Code
property.description: Must match a Region's Country Code.

property.caption: To Country Code
property.description: Must match a Region's Country Code.

property.caption: Enable Zoom & Pan
property.description: Scroll/pinch to zoom, drag to pan, double-click to reset.

property.caption: Marker Color Mode
property.description: Fixed: every marker uses Marker Color. By Status/By Category: markers are coloured automatically per distinct Status/Category value, each with its own legend entry (falls back to a single "undefined" colour for regions missing that attribute).

property.caption: Marker Color
property.description: Only used when Marker Color Mode is Fixed Color.

property.caption: Min Marker Size (px)
property.description: Bubble size for the smallest Value (or the fixed size when Value is unbound).

property.caption: Max Marker Size (px)
property.description: Bubble size for the largest Value.

property.caption: Show Region Labels
property.description: Always show each region's name next to its marker instead of only on hover.

property.caption: Selected Region ID Attribute
property.description: Written with the clicked region's ID.

property.caption: On Region Click
property.description: Executed after the Selected Region ID Attribute (if any) has been written.
